record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>, to bring to remembrance<WH02142><WTH8687>.<Fo><Fo> O LORD<WH03068>, rebuke<WH03198><WTH8686> me not in thy wrath<WH07110>: neither chasten<WH03256><WTH8762> me in thy hot displeasure<WH02534>.
For thine arrows<WH02671> stick fast<WH05181><WTH8738> in me, and thy hand<WH03027> presseth me sore<WH05181><WTH8799>.

<FI> There is<Fi> no soundness<WH04974> in my flesh<WH01320> because<WH06440> of thine anger<WH02195>; neither <FI>is there any<Fi> rest<WH07965> in my bones<WH06106> because<WH06440> of my sin<WH02403>. <RF>rest: Heb. peace, or, health<Rf>
For mine iniquities<WH05771> are gone over<WH05674><WTH8804> mine head<WH07218>: as an heavy<WH03515> burden<WH04853> they are too heavy<WH03513><WTH8799> for me.
My wounds<WH02250> stink<WH0887><WTH8689> <FI>and<Fi> are corrupt<WH04743><WTH8738> because<WH06440> of my foolishness<WH0200>.
I am troubled<WH05753><WTH8738>; I am bowed down<WH07817><WTH8804> greatly<WH03966>; I go<WH01980><WTH8765> mourning<WH06937><WTH8802> all the day<WH03117> long. <RF>troubled: Heb. wried<Rf>
For my loins<WH03689> are filled<WH04390><WTH8804> with a loathsome<WH07033><WTH8737> <FI>disease<Fi> : and <FI>there is<Fi> no soundness<WH04974> in my flesh<WH01320>.
I am feeble<WH06313><WTH8738> and sore<WH03966> broken<WH01794><WTH8738>: I have roared<WH07580><WTH8804> by reason of the disquietness<WH05100> of my heart<WH03820>.
Lord<WH0136>, all my desire<WH08378> <FI>is<Fi> before thee; and my groaning<WH0585> is not hid<WH05641><WTH8738> from thee.

My heart<WH03820> panteth<WH05503><WTH8773>, my strength<WH03581> faileth<WH05800><WTH8804> me: as for the light<WH0216> of mine eyes<WH05869>, it<WH01992> also is gone<WH0369> from me. <RF>is gone...: Heb. is not with me<Rf>

My lovers<WH0157><WTH8802> and my friends<WH07453> stand<WH05975><WTH8799> aloof from<WH05048> my sore<WH05061>; and my kinsmen<WH07138> stand<WH05975><WTH8804> afar off<WH07350>. <RF>sore: Heb. stroke<Rf> <RF>my kinsmen: or, my neighbours<Rf><CM>

They also that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> after my life<WH05315> lay snares<WH05367><WTH8762> <FI>for me<Fi> : and they that seek<WH01875><WTH8802> my hurt<WH07451> speak<WH01696><WTH8765> mischievous things<WH01942>, and imagine<WH01897><WTH8799> deceits<WH04820> all the day<WH03117> long.
But I, as a deaf<WH02795> <FI>man<Fi> , heard<WH08085><WTH8799> not; and <FI>I was<Fi> as a dumb man<WH0483> <FI>that<Fi> openeth<WH06605><WTH8799> not his mouth<WH06310>.
Thus I was as a man<WH0376> that heareth<WH08085><WTH8802> not, and in whose mouth<WH06310> <FI>are<Fi> no reproofs<WH08433>.
For in thee, O LORD<WH03068>, do I hope<WH03176><WTH8689>: thou wilt hear<WH06030><WTH8799>, O Lord<WH0136> my God<WH0430>. <RF>in...: or, thee do I wait for<Rf> <RF>hear: or, answer<Rf>

For I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, <FI>Hear me<Fi> , lest <FI>otherwise<Fi> they should rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> over me: when my foot<WH07272> slippeth<WH04131><WTH8800>, they magnify<WH01431><WTH8689> <FI>themselves<Fi> against me.
For I <FI>am<Fi> ready<WH03559><WTH8737> to halt<WH06761>, and my sorrow<WH04341> <FI>is<Fi> continually<WH08548> before me. <RF>to halt: Heb. for halting<Rf>
For I will declare<WH05046><WTH8686> mine iniquity<WH05771>; I will be sorry<WH01672><WTH8799> for my sin<WH02403>.

But mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> <FI>are<Fi> lively<WH02416>, <FI>and<Fi> they are strong<WH06105><WTH8804>: and they that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me wrongfully<WH08267> are multiplied<WH07231><WTH8804>. <RF>are lively...: Heb. being living, are strong<Rf>
They also that render<WH07999><WTH8764> evil<WH07451> for good<WH02896> are mine adversaries<WH07853><WTH8799>; because I follow<WH07291><WTH8800> <FI>the thing that<Fi> good<WH02896> <FI>is<Fi> .
Forsake<WH05800><WTH8799> me not, O LORD<WH03068>: O my God<WH0430>, be not far<WH07368><WTH8799> from me.
Make haste<WH02363><WTH8798> to help<WH05833> me, O Lord<WH0136> my salvation<WH08668>. <RF>to...: Heb. for my help<Rf><CM>
